title: Grateful Dead Live at Field House - University of Cincinnati on 1970-04-03

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard capture of a solid 1970 set with an acoustic opener and a fiery Other One‑Lovelight stretch, marred only by occasional pops and static.
ai_review.review: The recording is a slight upgrade over the other source – a soundboard mix that’s properly pitched and timed, though it has some pops, crackles and stray static. Musically the show delivers an intimate acoustic set (Friend of the Devil, Katie Mae) and a powerful second half highlighted by The Other One through Lovelight, with Pigpen’s vocal climax and tight drums on Good Lovin'.

ai_rating.rationale: Five reviews, four of them 4‑5 stars, praise both the performance (standout acoustic set and intense closing) and the recording (proper pitch, better track splits), with only minor technical complaints.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Properly pitched/timed; tracks like China Cat/Rider and Good Lovin' are cleanly separated. Minor pops, crackles and stray static noted, but overall hot and listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Includes a nicely placed acoustic set that opens the show, smooth transitions (e.g., China Cat → Rider) and a continuous, high‑energy stretch from The Other One through Lovelight.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia shines in the intimate acoustic setting, improves lyrics on Friend of the Devil, and delivers strong guitar work on Katie Mae.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums are highlighted as solid and uninterrupted on Good Lovin', adding to the tight feel of the set.
